limits: Target-workload qualification on one Windows/NTFS host, not a universal latency or platform-matrix guarantee.
Fresh processes reuse the workload and OS caches; no cold-cache guarantee.
Whole validation includes current-plan parsing, complete retained-record authentication, both-direction fresh comparisons, inventories, witnesses, worker retirement and native-handle release.
Registry/generation/publication lock wait is separate; observer mutex wait is included in validation.
Live qualification forbids reconciliation/publication/reset and creates no tokens; mutation behavior is qualified in isolated upgrade/integration tests.
USN witness posting changes counted journal metadata, not ownership records, file contents or names.
Capability, witness, namespace, alias, resource-budget or ordinary comparison failure after safe cleanup runs full reference validation and can exceed 30 seconds.
Failed worker retirement aborts the operation before mutation, preserving bindings until native retirement is proved.
No atomic namespace freeze or guarantee against noncooperative record writers; existing mutation-time checks and v1 writer locks remain necessary.
